patch_resolves_note: The staged fixed-source rebuild applied the upstream `malloc(other->keylen)` plus `memcpy(..., other->keylen)` change in `ucl_object_copy_internal()`, and the fixed original still executed the same inherited-key copy and hash path with `copy_bytes == keylen_after == hash_len == 333` instead of the vulnerable `122 < 333` mismatch.

nodes.description: At the `_mum_hash_aligned()` sink, the vulnerable execution hashes 333 bytes from the copied key even though the copied key storage created at the root site only spans 122 bytes before the first embedded-NUL truncation point.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `hash_word_read.hash_len=333` and `hash_word_read.copy_bytes=122` immediately before the crashing MUM word read.

edges.description: The same copied key pointer installed into `new->key` at the root copy site is the `key` argument consumed by `_mum_hash_aligned()` on the crashing hash path.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `copy_key_post.key_ptr == hash_word_read.hash_key_ptr` on the crashing case.

edges.description: The preserved logical key length carried in `new->keylen` reaches `_mum_hash_aligned()` unchanged as the `len` argument that drives the out-of-bounds read.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `copy_key_post.keylen_after == hash_word_read.hash_len == 333`.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the copied key storage spans at least `new->keylen` bytes
root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `ucl_object_copy_internal()` duplicates a key through `other->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY]`, the copy operation must preserve `other->keylen` bytes rather than stop at the first embedded NUL. Otherwise the copied object returns with the original logical `new->keylen` but a shorter backing allocation in `new->trash_stack[UCL_TRASH_KEY]` / `new->key`, and later hashing reads past that copied storage.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original executes the protected hash path with `copy_key_post.copy_bytes=122` and `copy_key_post.keylen_after=333`, so the copy span is shorter than the preserved logical key length. The fixed original executes the same protected event genuinely with `copy_key_post.copy_bytes=333` and `copy_key_post.keylen_after=333`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The required predicate is violated on the crashing vulnerable original while `hash_word_read` executes, and it is genuinely satisfied on the clean fixed original while the same protected hash event executes.
